title: Austin Hires City Lobbyist for $40K
summary:
*   Austin city leaders held a special meeting to make a key personnel decision.
*   They met privately to discuss and interview candidates for a City lobbyist position.
*   Following the closed session, the council publicly voted to hire Dick Brown as the City of Austin's new lobbyist.
*   Brown's approved annual salary for this role was set at $40,000.

RECESS
Council recessed at 5:00p.m. for executive session and resumed its recessed meeting at
5:34 p.m. LOBBYIST CHOSEN The Council, on Mayor Pro Tem Trevino's motion, Councilmember
Spaeth's second, approved the hiring of Dick Brown with a salary of $40,000 a year as
lobbyist for the City of Austin. (6-0 Vote, Councilmember Duncan absent.)
